text: 5.2 1 A It has some beautiful original features. B It looks as though it's about to collapse. 2 A acquiring such an old building could be a huge mistake. B Really? I think the project is going to be a great success. 3 A It would be more of a transformation if we built a modern building made of materials like steel and glass. B Couldn't we do both? We'll maintain more of a connection to the past if we include the old building as part of the new one.
